domain.description: Sends a leaf, or the kind above its leaves when the question is which kind; a shelf, domain or top answers `not_a_leaf`.

key.description: Names the key from the domain read; `price` is a key every domain has.

op.description: Sends the operator the domain read listed for this key.

value.description: Sends the desired value, typed by the key's type.

currency.description: On money, the currency the bound is tested in: sil holds no exchange rate, so it is tested against offers in this currency only. Leave it out to mean the buyer's own currency, as `sil_whoami` answers it.

specs.description: Sends every settled want as a spec with the operator it needs; on a kind, `leaf` in or nin its leaves. A key the place does not hold is recorded, never refused.

query.description: Sends words only for what no spec holds, never a sentence.

brief.description: Ties the call to a brief in sil’s record; never required.
